svg.title: Infrastructure as Code
svg.desc: Infrastructure as Code. Define infrastructure in version-controlled code: review a plan, apply it the same way in every environment and catch drift. Step 1, Built by hand: Clicked together in the console: production lacks encryption and backups; a rebuild takes 3 days. Step 2, Declare it, plan it: returns.tf uses the platform's modules; PR #418's plan shows 10 to add, and 12 policy checks pass. Step 3, Apply it the same way: Run #57 applies staging, then production, with different .tfvars; a state lock makes run #58 wait. Step 4, Drift and pitfalls: A port opened by hand shows up as drift overnight. Beware plans that replace data, and leaky state.
